topic: Which magical adventure would you choose?

files.name: 01.png
files.label: THE STAR ATLAS
files.must_show: A large open celestial atlas with golden constellations dominates a moonlit observatory desk, with a brass telescope behind it.
files.observed_subject: A large open antique atlas with gold constellation illustrations occupies the foreground desk of a moonlit observatory.

files.name: 02.png
files.label: THE SUNSET BALLOON
files.must_show: A large ornate red and cream hot air balloon with a wicker basket hovers beside a stone terrace above a waterfall valley at sunset.
files.observed_subject: A red and cream hot air balloon with a hanging wicker basket fills the upper foreground over a sunset valley.

files.name: 03.png
files.label: THE FLOATING PALACE
files.must_show: A marble domed palace pavilion stands on a floating island amid violet wisteria and waterfalls above a sea of clouds.
files.observed_subject: A marble pavilion with a dome and arches stands prominently on a floating island surrounded by wisteria and waterfalls.

files.name: 04.png
files.label: THE CASTLE TEA TERRACE
files.must_show: A stone terrace with tea service and pastries in the foreground overlooks a majestic cliffside castle and waterfalls at sunset.
files.observed_subject: A stone breakfast table with tea and pastries overlooks a towering castle on a cliff beside cascading waterfalls.

files.name: 05.png
files.label: THE SUNSET TREEHOUSE
files.must_show: A large lantern-lit wooden treehouse and rope bridge occupy the foreground in a tropical tree canopy above misty mountains at sunset.
files.observed_subject: A large lantern-lit wooden treehouse and rope bridge fill the foreground above a sunset mountain valley.
